title: SII Vol. 19 No. 274 — Valappur-nadu
location_detail: On the door-jamb, left of entrance, of the central shrine, Arappalisvara temple
summary: It records an endowment of a quarter sey of land as sala ppuram, left in charge of the urar of the village for the celebration of the annual Karttigai festival in the temple of Tiruvarappalliyalvar by Pratigandan Darachcholan

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 275
location_detail: On a broken slab in the mandapa of the same temple

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 504
summary: It seems to record the grant of half a sey of land to the temple by the same donor and for the same purpose

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 276 — Tiruchchatturai
summary: It seems to record a gift of 90 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple, and another 50 for the supply of 4 nali of ghee on the days of sankranti every month for the sacred bath (?) of the god, by a lady who left them in charge of a local shepherd for the necessary supply

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 277
summary: This records a gift of 30 kalanju of gold for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple under the name Kumaramattandam, by Aliving-Kallarasi alias Sembiyan Buvanigangaraiyan

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 278 — Tiruvidaimarudur
location_detail: On the west wall of the central shrine, Mahalingasvami temple
summary: The portion of the inscription after line, 13 is completely damaged

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 280 — Konerirajapuram
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Umamahaesvara temple
summary: This records an endowment of land (after purchase0 for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple at Tirunallam a brahmadeya in Vennadu by one -¦ . .. Venkadan Singam alias Disai yayirat tainurruvan of Tiru[narayanapuram] (?)

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 281 — Alambakkam
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Varadaraja-Perumal temple
summary: This records an endowment of 3 ma of land situated below the Marpidugeri (tank) by Kanderu Sannapperumal-Somasi (Somayaji) a member of the alunganam of Dantivarmamangalam a brahmadeya on the northern bank of the river for maintaining a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tirumerrali-Perumal in the villa

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 282 — Tiruchchengattangudi
location_detail: On the north wall of the Ganapatisvara shrine, Uttarapatisvara temple
summary: This registers a sale of land tax-free to the temple of Paramesvara at Tiruchchengattangudi, for the maintenance of a perpetual lamp in the temple by the assembly of Marugal in Tirumarugal-nadu

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 283 — Udaiyarkudi near Katumannar koyil
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Anantisvara temple
summary: This records a gift of gold deposited with the temple authorities of Tiruvarantisvara for maintaining a perpetual lamp with an ulakku of ghee everyday, by Nakkarn Piratamadevi alias Mu[m]mudisola-Talaikkoli daughter of Sri-Arurttevanar

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 284 — Koyil-Tevarayanpettai near Pandaravadai
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Matsyapurisvara temple
summary: This records the gift of a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruchchelur-Mahadeva at Rajakesari-chaturvedimangalam by one Koyil Nilavani (Nilavanji) a member of the Madurantaka-terinja-Kaikkolar (regiment) An inscription of Uttama-Chola

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 285 — Sendalai
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Sundaresvara temple
summary: This is an incomplete inscription with the beginning portion also built in

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 286 — Tiruppalanam
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Apatsahayesvara temple
summary: This records a gift of 30 kalanju of gold for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Mahadeva at Tiruppalanam in Viraikkurram by Alivinkallarasiyar alias Pirudigangaraiyar sen of Mahadeva (the chief) of Pangala-nadu

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 288 — Lalgudi
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Saptarishisvara temple
summary: This records a gift of 90 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Perumahadigal at Tiruttavatturai in Idaiyaru-nadu by Kalanganilai Sokki wife of Mananilai Virapiran of Idaiyarrumangalam in the same nadu

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 289
summary: It records a gift of 90 sheep for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Perumanadigal at Tiruttavatturai by Tayan Se[n]dan of Nelkuppa in Tanjavur-kurram

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 290
summary: This registers the sale of a quarter (veli) of land to the temple of Mahadeva, exempt from taxes like irai, echchoru, vetti, vedinai and sennirvetti, by Tonan Adittapidaran of Pudukkudi near Karandai in Eyil-nadu for 15 kalanju of gold which was endowed to the temple for perpetual lamp by Uran Maran

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 291 — Valappuranadu
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Arappalisvara temple
summary: This records a decision (probably of the temple authorities), fixing a recurring (annual) payment of a kalanju of gold as remuneration to four persons, for conducting the three daily services in the temple of Tiruvarappalli-Udaiyar with twelve nail of rice by the standard measure Tiruvellarai-kanam,

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 292 — Tirukkodikaval
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Tirukkotisvara temple
summary: This is evidently assignable to Uttama Chola

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 293 — Tiruppundurutti
location_detail: On the west wall of the central shrine, Pushpavanesvara temple
summary: This is very probably an inscription of Parantaka I

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 294 — Tiruchchatturai
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Odanavanesvara temple
summary: This records an endowment made by Malapadan Malapadi a merchant of Mandipuram alias Ayirattali for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruchchorrutturai-Madeva with an ulakku of ghee every day, and the setting up of an image of the goddess as consort of [V di]-Vidangar (procession image), by
